headline: Tile status artwork restored to full visibility in Nutdex and on game boards

changes.title: Restore the full translucent overlay illustrations
changes.detail: Removed the radial mask that had cut away most of the tile-status images. All 16 original transparent overlay PNGs remain intact, visible in the Nutdex and layered above ordinary nuts during play.

changes.title: Prepare independent Google Play upload signing
changes.detail: The Android build now supports separately configured Play upload credentials without replacing the existing test-build signing identity or changing the game's currency and account data.
